conclusion: SupportCacheBudget derives optional support working-storage allowances from physical and live available RAM, reserves system and working headroom, disables extras at 4 GiB or less or under pressure, and shares estimated temporary reservations across concurrent trees using SupportBatchBudget RAII. It does not cap mandatory model storage or enforce a process RSS limit.
